alt: Pepperoni pizza topped with candy corn kernels on a dark surface, Tombstone's 2026 Halloween pizza kit alongside the box packaging
story: For Halloween 2026, Tombstone launched a $1.31 kit where you add candy corn to frozen pepperoni pizza — a product they marketed under the official name 'The Pizza Nobody Asked For,' with three limited online drops throughout October.
why_funny: Tombstone essentially published its own one-star review as the product title and sold it anyway.
